## DASDAE {.smaller}

:::{.fragment}
DASCore is one part of the growing DAS Data Analysis Ecosystem, [DASDAE](https://github.com/DASDAE). Other projects include:
:::

:::{.tight}
:::{.incremental}
- [das-anomaly](https://github.com/DASDAE/das-anomaly): anomaly detection with auto-encoders
- [DerZug](https://github.com/DASDAE/derzug): interactive processing and visualizations
- [DASJax](https://github.com/DASDAE/dasjax): DASCore kernels compiled for CPU and GPU (notebook 04)
- [unidas](https://github.com/DASDAE/unidas): move data between DASCore, DASPy, Lightguide and Xdas
:::
:::

## Call to arms {.smaller}

:::{.tight}
:::{.incremental}
- Give [DASCore](https://github.com/DASDAE/dascore) and [Xdas](https://github.com/xdas-dev/xdas) a star — it helps justify working on them
- If you like DASCore, please help us test the [`dev` branch](https://github.com/DASDAE/dascore/tree/dev) ahead of the 1.0 release
  - Feedback on the API and the `Inventory` would be especially useful
- If you are building DFOS tools, check out [extending DASCore](https://dascore.org/contributing/extending_dascore.html)
- Build, and share, something cool
:::
:::
